items.html: The Kamatz indicates the Keter, and the Keter is tastes. The Patach indicates Hochma, and they are the dots. Hence, these two dots are called Kamatz and Patach, as they imply the above matter, which is that as long as only the tastes of SAG emerged, which are the lights of AHP, the lights were still blocked and reduced. When the dots came—which are Hochma, which is Patach, and is the phase of Ayin—they were opened in the opening of the eyes, as mentioned in the Tikkunim [in The Zohar]. This is the meaning of the dots of Patach. However, initially, in the phases of tastes, which are Keter, it is Kamatz, since the lights were reduced and blocked.
